experiment_name: Continuous SetOperator Lead Geometry Ablations
primary_question: Can continuous coordinate conditioning break set-token symmetry in multi-lead ECG?
primary_finding: Failed. Continuous coordinate queries collapsed token variance. Raw 1D ResNet outperformed SetOperator by 0.39 AUROC.

experiment_name: Duration-Aware Semi-Markov Temporal Decoding
primary_question: Does duration-aware semi-Markov decoding improve continuous density and boundary estimation over pointwise detectors?
primary_finding: Validated. Semi-Markov D2 cut density MAE from 0.1230 to 0.0839 (-31.8%) and episode boundary error from 125.7s to 48.1s.

experiment_name: Window-Resolution Oracle Evaluation
primary_question: What is the theoretical upper bound on episode reconstruction under fixed windowing (5s, 10s, 30s, 60s)?
primary_finding: Quantization ceiling. 30s fixed windowing imposes an unavoidable boundary jitter of ~15s; 60s windows fail on micro-bursts <30s.

experiment_name: Standardized Matched Detector Benchmark on Informative Windows
primary_question: How do ResNet, RR-GBDT, RawECGNet, and SetOperator compare under identical train/val splits and informative windows?
primary_finding: Raw Mask ResNet (AUROC 0.9872, BSS 0.8346) and RR-GBDT (AUROC 0.9723, BSS 0.7148) dominate; SetOperator failed (AUROC 0.5905).

experiment_name: Calibrated Noise Stress Testing via MIT-BIH NSTDB
primary_question: How robust are raw waveform and RR detectors under calibrated SNR (-6 dB to +24 dB)?
primary_finding: Raw waveform ResNet degrades steeply below 0 dB SNR; RR-GBDT maintains higher robustness provided QRS detector handles noise.

experiment_name: Authentic Real-World Noise Benchmark on Multi-Device Holters
primary_question: Does real-world electrode artifact corrupt RR variability (VCC) and AF detection?
primary_finding: Catastrophic inversion. Under N2 noise, sinus rhythm VCC inflates to 48.93%, exceeding true AF (47.46%), destroying specificity.

experiment_name: Landmark Conditional Termination Hazard Analysis
primary_question: Does the instantaneous hazard of AF termination decrease as episode duration lengthens?
primary_finding: Confirmed. 15m conditional termination hazard collapses from 0.530 min^-1 at 15s to 0.015 min^-1 at 1h (Spearman rho = -1.0000).

experiment_name: Episode Duration Survival and Heterogeneity Modeling
primary_question: Do episode survival distributions follow an exponential (constant hazard) or power/Weibull decay?
primary_finding: Log-rank and KM survival curves show severe departure from exponentiality, confirming strong duration dependence.

experiment_name: Shared Gamma Frailty Weibull Survival Modeling
primary_question: Is positive duration dependence an ecological artifact of inter-patient heterogeneity?
primary_finding: Genuine within-patient entrenchment. Within-patient shape alpha_within = 0.5854 << 1.0 (frailty variance sigma^2 = 2.340, p < 1e-100); 85.1% of patients exhibit alpha_i < 1.0.

experiment_name: Cycle-to-Cycle Ventricular Variation across Episode Duration
primary_question: Does ventricular cycle-to-cycle variation (VCC) stabilize or change as AF episodes entrench?
primary_finding: Weak association. VCC shifts marginally with episode duration (rho = -0.082) but is heavily confounded by autonomic tone and ambient rate.

experiment_name: Clinical Trial Discordance under 6-Minute CIED Thresholds
primary_question: What fraction of clinically active paroxysmal AF patients are misclassified as AF-free under CIED 6m cutoffs?
primary_finding: Severe discordance. 26 patients (8.0% of AF cohort) have verified recurrent AF >=30s that never reaches 6m, suffering false-negative trial adjudication.

experiment_name: Pre-AF Atrial Ectopy and Premature Ventricular/Atrial Characteristics
primary_question: Does PMV elevation precede AF onset with temporal specificity suitable for onset prediction?
primary_finding: Non-specific. Pre-AF PMV elevation reflects isolated PAC/PVC ectopy rather than impending fibrillatory transition; high false positive rate.

experiment_name: Post-AF Transient PMV Dynamics and Atrial Stunning Trajectory
primary_question: Does PMV show a transient elevation immediately following AF termination, decaying over 30-60 minutes?
primary_finding: Robust descriptive phenomenon. Fixed panel median PMV declines by 16.58% (MAD representation +22.77% early elevation, p = 0.0031); diff-in-diff vs sinus controls p = 0.0157.

experiment_name: Leak-Free Landmark Cox Modeling of Post-AF Recurrence
primary_question: Does early post-AF PMV predict subsequent AF recurrence independent of prior AF history?
primary_finding: Artifact of immortal time and confounding. In unadjusted models, HR = 0.8453; after leak-free 120s landmark and prior history adjustment, HR = 0.9983 (p = 0.9842).

experiment_name: Measurement Identifiability: Temporal Aggregation vs Continuity
primary_question: What proportion of unique rhythm configurations and continuity information is lost under binned temporal aggregation?
primary_finding: Mathematical & empirical loss. 45% to 68% of unique rhythm permutations are non-identifiable under 1-hour binning.

experiment_name: Ventricular Rate Heterogeneity in Burden/Density-Matched Cohorts
primary_question: Among recordings with matched burden and density, does continuous episode duration predict distinct ventricular rates?
primary_finding: Null association. Partial correlation between longest episode duration and mean ventricular rate is r = 0.042 (p = 0.618).

experiment_name: Rapid-AF Temporal Localization in High-Density Segments
primary_question: Do highest-density temporal segments contain disproportionate rapid ventricular response (>110 bpm)?
primary_finding: Partially supported. Rapid ventricular episodes cluster into high-density periods with rate ratio 1.42 (p = 0.012), driven by diurnal autonomic modulation.

experiment_name: Rosman Joint Burden-Density Phenotype Replication
primary_question: Does the 4x4 burden-density category matrix reproduce published CIED distributions in ambulatory Holters?
primary_finding: Cohort-dependent translation. Ambulatory Holters exhibit 61.8% High-Density (vs 54.9% published CIED) under 12h horizon, but undefinable at b=0/b=1.

experiment_name: Observation Horizon Phenotype Migration
primary_question: How stable are Rosman burden-density phenotypes across nested observation windows (1h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h, 48h, 72h)?
primary_finding: Severe migration. 36.2% of patients migrate category between 12h and full recording; quadratic weighted kappa = 0.542.

experiment_name: Comparative Temporal Metric Rank Stability
primary_question: Does AF density provide higher patient-level rank stability than AF burden or longest episode share?
primary_finding: Burden is more stable. Spearman rank correlation across nested horizons is rho = 0.891 for burden vs rho = 0.684 for density.

experiment_name: SHDB-AF Left Atrial Diameter Structural Modeling
primary_question: Is AF density independently associated with echocardiographic left atrial diameter (LAD)?
primary_finding: High-leverage artifact. In multi-run subset, beta_D = -13.60 mm (p = 0.0089) is driven by single outlier (shdb_4339581, Cook's D=0.171). In contemporaneous echos (|Delta t| <= 90d, N=44), beta_D flips to +7.77 mm (p = 0.3086).

experiment_name: Atrial Fibrillatory Rate (AFR) Extraction and Validation
primary_question: Can reliable fibrillatory rate spectra (4-9 Hz) be extracted from single/two-lead ambulatory Holter signals?
primary_finding: Unreliable on ambulatory Holter. Spatiotemporal QRST cancellation residual harmonic power exceeds 38%; dominant frequency peak tracking has coefficient of variation >32%.

experiment_name: Historical Density Feasibility Attrition Audit
primary_question: Why did earlier agent reports claim only 6 patients were eligible for density analysis when SHDB contains 98 records?
primary_finding: Audited & resolved. Earlier code enforced impossible joint filters (multi-run + contemporaneous echo + raw waveform extraction + AFR). True reference cohort contains 72 patients with defined density and LAD.
